chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Trim your nails on Tuesday, bathe on Wednesday, fulfil your need for cupping (hijama) on Thursday, and use your best fragrance on Jumu'ah.

key_terms.أَظْفَارَكُمْ: Your nails, as part of personal grooming

ai.seo_question: What did the Imam عليه السلام recommend for nail trimming, bathing, cupping, and fragrance during the week?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a weekly pattern of personal cleanliness and grooming, assigning recommended acts to specific days. It reflects the Islamic emphasis on taharah, beautification, and orderly habits, especially in preparation for Jumu'ah.
